lines: #When you keep a promise to yourself, you're saying *I matter.*
#And when you keep breaking those promises?
You make plans, and part of you already knows you won't *follow* through.
Make a tiny promise. And *keep* it.
Ten minutes of reading. A glass of *water.* One walk.
Then make another. And *keep* that too.
Don't start with a mountain. Start with a *step.*
The goal right now isn't the result.
#You start to believe your own *words* again.
And a person who believes their own words is very hard to *stop.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: Discipline Isn't Punishment. It's Self-Respect.
post.caption: Every kept promise is a deposit. Rebuild the trust with yourself. 🔥
post.first_comment: What small promise will you keep today? 👇
